protocol.method: PIXIE (Le et al., github.com/vlongle/pixie) released UNets: checkpoints_discrete/20250505_013424/epoch_510.pth (8-class material segmentation) + checkpoints_continuous_mse/20250805_040343/epoch_250.pth (density, E, nu); input = 64^3 CLIP ViT-L/14@336 feature voxel grid of the static object (see pixie_features.py docstring for faithful vs approximated steps)

class_mapping_a_priori.background: jelly (majority train law; only if every mask voxel were background)
class_mapping_a_priori.rationale: our laws: jelly = elastic (FCR), metal = elastic + von Mises yield (StVK), plasticine = elastoplastic/irreversible; PIXIE ids follow PhysGaussian MPM (0 jelly, 1 metal, 2 sand, 3 visplas, 4 fluid, 5 snow, 6 stationary, 7 background); every PIXIE flow/plastic class goes to plasticine

protocol.aggregation: object = majority PIXIE class over occupied voxels (background excluded); E, nu, rho = medians over occupied voxels
protocol.targets: specific space as V2: E/(rho/1000), nu, rho, sigma_y/(rho/1000); ln1p + z-score with train stats (data/manifests/v2main.specific.stats.json). PIXIE has no yield stress -> sigma_y/rho prediction = train mean (z = 0), same as the constant baseline
protocol.primary_variant: filled (occupancy with interior filled); shell variant reported as sensitivity
protocol.metric: identical to docs/v3c/BASELINES_VAL.json (scripts/v3c/baselines_report.score); bootstrap = scripts/bootstrap_object_ci.compare vs V-JEPA C seeds
protocol.test_rule: test scored once, only after val numbers were written to this file
protocol.calibrated_variant: filled_train_calibrated: PIXIE also run on the 87 TRAIN objects; per parameter (E/rho, nu, rho) an OLS map z_target = a + b * z_pixie is fitted on train samples only and applied to val/test (fixes PIXIE's real-world absolute scale vs our sampled parameter ranges; laws unchanged). Added after the first val scoring showed the scale mismatch; fixed before test.
